- **AirPods Pro 3 (USB-C) → AirPods Pro 4 (USB-C).** The link is still the general `apple.com/airpods-pro/` page.
- **Apple Watch Ultra 3 → Apple Watch Ultra 4.** The link now goes to `apple.com/apple-watch-ultra-4/`.

I checked that all three Apple links load.
